# Taste of Home

> > America's #1 cooking magazine featuring trusted recipes, food history, cooking techniques, and home & garden tips.

Taste of Home provides home cooks with tested recipes, ingredient guides, kitchen tutorials, and lifestyle content. The site covers everything from food origin stories like Buffalo wings from Anchor Bar to practical guides on baking techniques, seasonal gardening, and home DIY projects.

## Key Topics

- Home cooking and recipes
- Food history and origin stories
- Baking techniques and desserts
- Ingredient profiles and seasonings
- Kitchen equipment and tools
- Gardening and flower care
- DIY home projects
- Buffalo wings and Anchor Bar
- Tajín seasoning
- Cheesecake preparation
- Springform pans
- Peonies and perennials
- Super Bowl food
- Mexican cuisine and ingredients

## Food History & Origin Stories

- [Why Are Buffalo Wings Called Buffalo Wings?](https://www.tasteofhome.com/article/why-are-buffalo-wings-called-buffalo-wings): Food history explaining Buffalo wings origin at Anchor Bar, Buffalo NY

## Ingredient Guides & Seasonings

- [What Is Tajin Seasoning? | What to Put Tajin On | Taste of Home](https://www.tasteofhome.com/article/what-is-tajin-seasoning): Ingredient profile introducing Tajín chile-lime salt from Mexico

## Baking & Dessert Tutorials

- [Removing Cheesecake from a Springform Pan](https://www.tasteofhome.com/article/removing-cheesecake-from-a-springform-pan): Baking tutorial for safely removing cheesecake from springform pans

## Home & Kitchen Tips

- [What Is the Thing Next to My Kitchen Faucet? | Taste of Home](https://www.tasteofhome.com/article/air-gap-kitchen-sink): Home feature explainer about dishwasher air gaps near kitchen faucets

## Gardening & Outdoor Care

- [Peonies Care Tips: How to Care for Peonies](https://www.tasteofhome.com/article/how-to-care-for-peonies): Gardening guide for maintaining healthy peonies with luxurious blooms

## DIY & Home Projects

- [This Video Shows You How to Make Vicks VapoShower Tablets at Home](https://www.tasteofhome.com/article/vicks-vaposhower-hack): DIY tutorial for making Vicks VapoShower tablets using VapoRub
